text:
The mouse eradication on Gough Island first commenced in 2021. The planned 2020 attempt was called off because of COVID-19 travel restrictions, and the main operation went ahead in 2021, with the team reaching the island by ship in June. My earlier detail about "late-2021" aerial baiting doesn't match these sources, which point to bait distribution in June 2021. Sources: [Gough Island Restoration Programme (SANAP)](https://www.sanap.ac.za/?p=32982) and [ACAP news on the 2021 advance party](https://www.acap.aq/latest-news/advance-party-leaves-cape-town-for-gough-island-to-eradicate-its-introduced-mice-and-save-the-critically-endangered-tristan-albatross.md).
